purpose: Switch RELEASE_CrowdField on both maps (Candidate48 first) from six frozen posed meshes to the six VAT-baked PilgrimRigV3 bodies of Scripts/create_crowd_vat_v2.py, with the vertex-animation runtime in AMikdashCrowdField turned on. One actor per map is touched; every other actor is snapshot-compared.

why.crowd_count: Both maps carried 240 (candidate-parity-20260910T020232999990Z.json), not the 10,000 class default. 1,600 sits inside the 1,500-2,500 the VAT plan named: each figure is 2,400 triangles against the old 1,228, and at UpdateBudgetPerFrame 500 one sweep is 4 frames, so the material extrapolates at most a few hundredths of a second at 60 fps. Frame time is measured before and after in the packaged build; lower this if the cost is not acceptable.
why.freeze_distance_cm: Raised to the cull distance. A frozen vertex-animated figure is committed and set to idle, so freezing no longer means a statue, but walkers between 120 and 300 m should keep walking: the crowd lives at 30-200 m and the per-frame CPU cost is bounded by the budget, not by the distance.
why.mesh_yaw_offset_degrees: PilgrimRigV3 bodies face +Y after the glTF import; the crowd heading convention is +X.
why.paused_group_resume_seconds: A paused visitor party stood forever: 13 of 54 parties were paused at the end of the 8 Sep PIE run. Paused parties now idle (limbs moving) and after ~9-15 s turn back for their anchor.
why.garment_palette_size: M_CrowdVAT_V1 carries the 8-entry palette of release_crowd_tint_fix.spec.json; the tint index goes out as index/(N-1).
why.bob_lean: Zeroed for the record; the vertex-animation path ignores them because the clip carries its own 3.99 cm pelvis bob and 4.4 cm sway.

notTouched: the 24 MikdashResidentCharacter residents and their walk
every other actor (scene snapshot compared before save)
vatMasterWhy: M_CrowdVAT_V1 (Custom-node HLSL fed by per-instance data) crashed ShaderCompileWorker in the cp19 cook; replaced by the stock-node M_CrowdVAT_V2 (create_crowd_vat_v2.py -CrowdVatMaterialV2) and V1 removed from Content.
